hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: An alternating contiguous sequence ending at index i extends the alternating sequence ending at index i - 1 if elements differ.

hints.title: Streak Counting
hints.text: If current value does not equal previous value, the streak length increments by one, otherwise resets to one.

hints.title: Total Sum
hints.text: Accumulate the streak length at each position to obtain the grand total of alternating subarrays.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass with constant extra storage.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested subarray validation causes timeout.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that each position contributes its current alternating run length.
